testResults.name: thesis-operations-security-recovery-integrity
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/thesis/operations -q
testResults.result: 76 passed, 2 skipped (pre-existing pyyaml skips in the integration-owned contract tests): 32 new tests covering cross-workspace access (event stream, artifact source, Azure entity key substitution), prompt injection (untrusted-data precedence and instruction-like flagging), secret exfiltration (payload scan, manifest secret rejection, provider credential redaction), confused deputy (role tool policy denial), stale worker (late result retained and stale epoch fenced), repository budget/retention, and provider-auth offline fallback; plus runbook documentation-contract assertions

testResults.name: lint-format-type-gates
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev ruff check . && uv run --extra dev ruff format --check . && uv run --extra dev ty check
testResults.result: ruff check all passed; 556 files already formatted; ty check all passed

limitations: Recovery planning is read-only and delegates to the existing queue, checkpoint, and publication primitives; it does not itself mutate durable state
Repository size measurement and backup/restore operate on a local path with an injectable size port; Azure-backed measurement reuses the same contract
Realistic option/tick Git performance measurement and live-activation gates remain Phase 6 roadmap items outside T175
